abilities.name: Afterimage
abilities.short: After using a damaging move, the user creates an afterimage. Making the next attack against it have a chance to miss.
abilities.effect: After using a damaging move, the user creates an afterimage. Making the next attack against it have a 20% chance to miss.

abilities.name: Beak Force
abilities.short: Powers up pecking moves.
abilities.effect: Powers up pecking moves.

abilities.name: Blazing Heat
abilities.short: Boosts the Special Attack stat when the Pokemon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokemon also cannot be burned.
abilities.effect: Boosts the Special Attack stat by one stage when the Pokemon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokemon also cannot be burned.

abilities.name: Bountiful Harvest
abilities.short: At the end of each turn, the user consumes a random berry.
abilities.effect: At the end of each turn, the user consumes a random berry.

abilities.name: Celestial Wings
abilities.short: When entering battle, the pokemon creates Celestial Aura.
abilities.effect: When entering battle, the pokemon creates Celestial Aura, levitating all Pokemon on the field.

abilities.name: Chromatic Shift
abilities.short: When hit by a attack, the user becomes immune to that attack's type until hit by a different attacking type.
abilities.effect: When hit by a attack, the user becomes immune to that attack's type until hit by a different attacking type.

abilities.name: Compressed Core
abilities.short: When hit by a special attack, the user's special attack is greatly boosted.
abilities.effect: When hit by a special attack, the user's special attack is boosted by two stages.

abilities.name: Countercharge
abilities.short: When hit by a physical attack, the user's next physical attack is powered up.
abilities.effect: When hit by a physical attack, the user's next physical attack is powered up by 50%.

abilities.name: Counterweight
abilities.short: If the target weighs more than the user, it's physical moves increase in power.
abilities.effect: If the target weighs more than the user, it's physical moves increase in power by 30%.

abilities.name: Cruel Trick
abilities.short: Gives priority to status moves and when affecting a target with a status move, their speed is also reduced.
abilities.effect: Gives priority to status moves and when affecting a target with a status move, their speed is also reduced by one stage.

abilities.name: Cursed Brew
abilities.short: When the user drains HP from a Pokemon, that Pokemon's healing is reduced by half.
abilities.effect: When the user drains HP from a Pokemon, that Pokemon's healing is reduced by half.

abilities.name: Dominance
abilities.short: When an opposing Pokemon's HP falls below half, it's attack and special attack are reduced.
abilities.effect: When an opposing Pokemon's HP falls below half, it's attack and special attack are reduced by one stage.

abilities.name: Draconic Rush
abilities.short: Gives priority to Dragon-Type moves.
abilities.effect: Gives priority to Dragon-Type moves.

abilities.name: Duel Discipline
abilities.short: Mixing different attacking types boosts their power.
abilities.effect: Mixing different attacking types boost their power by 40%.

abilities.name: Earthshaker
abilities.short: The user's defense is doubled and prevents the user from receiving a critical hit.
abilities.effect: The user's defense is doubled and prevents the user from receiving a critical hit.

abilities.name: Emperors Decree
abilities.short: Opposing Pokemon cannot have their offensive stats raised while the user is on the field.
abilities.effect: Opposing Pokemon cannot have their offensive stats raised while the user is on the field.

abilities.name: Endless Hunger
abilities.short: The user heals half it's HP each time it knocks out a Pokemon.
abilities.effect: The user heals half it's maximum HP each time it knocks out a Pokemon. The move Aura Wheel always deal Dark-Type damage.

abilities.name: Everlasting Sands
abilities.short: The Pokemon changes the weather to potentially blind Pokemon.
abilities.effect: The Pokemon changes the weather to potentially blind Pokemon. Includes the effects of sandstorm and lowers the accuracy of all Pokemon by 20% that are not Ground and Rock Type.

abilities.name: Fluttering Dust
abilities.short: Powder moves used by the user affect all opposing pokemon.
abilities.effect: Powder moves used by the user affect all opposing pokemon.

abilities.name: Flying Fortress
abilities.short: When entering battle, the user's defense and special defense is boosted and gains immunity to Ground Type moves.
abilities.effect: When entering battle, the user's defense and special defense is boosted by one stage and gains immunity to Ground Type moves.

abilities.name: Freezing Gale
abilities.short: The Pokemon changes the weather to potentially freeze Pokemon.
abilities.effect: The Pokemon changes the weather to potentially freeze Pokemon. Includes the effects of snow and has 20% chance to freeze Pokemon every turn that are not Ice or Fire Type.

abilities.name: Ghostly Charm
abilities.short: The users Fairy-Type moves become Ghost-Type and can hit Normal-Type Pokemon.
abilities.effect: The users Fairy-Type moves become Ghost-Type and can hit Normal-Type Pokemon.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.short: When entering battle, the pokemon intensifies the gravity.
abilities.effect: When entering battle, the pokemon intensifies the gravity.

abilities.name: Haunting Flame
abilities.short: The user's fire moves can burn Fire-Types.
abilities.effect: The user's fire moves can burn Fire-Types.

abilities.name: Haunting Melody
abilities.short: Sound-based moves become Ghost-type moves and enables them to hit Normal-Type Pokemon.
abilities.effect: Sound-based moves become Ghost-type moves and enables them to hit Normal-Type Pokemon.

abilities.name: Headstrong
abilities.short: Head-based moves have increased power and chance to flinch.
abilities.effect: Head-based moves have 30% increased power and a 20% chance to flinch.

abilities.name: Improviser
abilities.short: Pikachu's moves ignore traditional rules gaining new interactions.
abilities.effect: Pikachu's moves ignore traditional rules gaining new interactions. General Rule: All Electric type attacks hit ground types for neutral damage. Quick attack: Becomes +4 priority instead of +1. Iron Tail: Can hit through protect with a 50% damage reduction. Electro Ball: Increases speed by one stage after use. Thunderbolt: Can paralyze ground-type and gains increased chance to paralyze increased to 40%. Volt Tackle: Ignores recoil damage.

abilities.name: Master Strike
abilities.short: Moves that make direct contact attack the target even if the target protects itself.
abilities.effect: Moves that make direct contact attack the target even if the target protects itself for 50% of the damage. This ability also bypasses Psychic Wall.

abilities.name: Overdrived
abilities.short: After the user uses Shift Gear, the next steel type move is powered up and inflicts burn.
abilities.effect: After the user uses Shift Gear, the next steel type move has 30% increased power and inflicts burn.

abilities.name: Primordial
abilities.short: When weather is created, the effect becomes enhanced.
abilities.effect: When weather is created, the effect becomes enhanced. Rain becomes Primordial Sea, Sun becomes Desolate Land, Snow becomes Freezing Gale, Sandstorm becomes Everlasting Sands.

abilities.name: Protective Instinct
abilities.short: When an ally is hit by a damaging move, the user's Attack is increased.
abilities.effect: When an ally is hit by a damaging move, the user's Attack is increased by one stage.

abilities.name: Psychic Wall
abilities.short: When entering battle, the user creates a invisible wall, making moves that make direct contact miss the user.
abilities.effect: When entering battle, the user creates a invisible wall, making moves that make direct contact miss the user.

abilities.name: Queen's Command
abilities.short: Vespiquen's Order moves gain additional effects.
abilities.effect: Vespiquen's Order moves gain additional effects. Attack Order: Raises itself and allies attack by one stage. Defend Order: Raises allies defense and special defense by one stage. Heal Order: Heals allies up to 25% of their maximum hp.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.short: Boosts the Special Attack stat after knocking out any Pokemon.
abilities.effect: Boosts the Special Attack stat by one stage after knocking out any Pokemon.

abilities.name: Spiky Defense
abilities.short: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact and lowers it's speed.
abilities.effect: Inflicts 1/8 maximum health damage on the attacker upon contact and lowers it's speed by one stage.

abilities.name: Spirit Guard
abilities.short: The user's Wonder Guard also protects it from status conditions and indirect damage.
abilities.effect: The user's Wonder Guard also protects it from status conditions and indirect damage.

abilities.name: Split Psyche
abilities.short: The user's mind is split into two, giving priority to status moves and raises special attack when it's stats are lowered.
abilities.effect: The user's mind is split into two, giving priority to status moves and raises special attack by one stage when it's stats are lowered.

abilities.name: Spore Cloud
abilities.short: Spore moves used by the user affect all opposing pokemon.
abilities.effect: Spore moves used by the user affect all opposing pokemon.

abilities.name: Static Rush
abilities.short: Gives priority to Electric-Type moves.
abilities.effect: Gives priority to Electric-Type moves.

abilities.name: Surging Psyche
abilities.short: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat on Electric or Psychic Terrain.
abilities.effect: Doubles the Pokemon's Speed stat on Electric or Psychic Terrain.

abilities.name: Toxic Voice
abilities.short: All sound-based moves become Poison-type moves.
abilities.effect: All sound-based moves become Poison-type moves.

abilities.name: Trickster
abilities.short: When entering battle, the user creates a bizarre area.
abilities.effect: When entering battle, the user creates Trick Room.

abilities.name: True Form
abilities.short: When entering battle for the first time, the user unleashes it's true form and strikes fear into all pokemon.
abilities.effect: When entering battle for the first time, the user unleashes it's true form and strikes fear into all pokemon.

abilities.name: True Wings
abilities.short: Gives priority to Flying-type moves.
abilities.effect: Gives priority to Flying-type moves.

abilities.name: Twin Artillery
abilities.short: Special attacks fire from both arm cannons, striking twice.
abilities.effect: Special attacks fire from both arm cannons, striking twice. The second hit for 30% of it's damage.

abilities.name: Volt Rush
abilities.short: When the user uses the move Volt Tackle, it's attack is boosted.
abilities.effect: When the user uses the move Volt Tackle, it's attack is boosted by one stage.

abilities.name: Wind Chaser
abilities.short: When entering battle, the pokemon creates tailwind.
abilities.effect: When entering battle, the pokemon creates tailwind.
